gates.name: Clean image build
gates.command: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 --no-cache --provenance=false --sbom=false --build-arg SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=0 --build-arg HTTPS_PROXY=http://host.docker.internal:7897 --build-arg HTTP_PROXY=http://host.docker.internal:7897 --output type=oci,rewrite-timestamp=true,dest=<unique-archive> E:\wave52-clean-5a474c2
gates.reviewer_note: Two clean no-cache candidate builds completed; isolated Compose readiness, Chat and SSE smoke were observed.

gates.name: Reproducible build
gates.command: Independent C/D no-cache OCI builds with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=0 and rewrite-timestamp=true
gates.reviewer_note: Manifest sha256:44486db8bb69095129d72cb1303937df117d968ffae703b8e3055a021fd5dacf; config sha256:d3416e357eab1846ec0c4423840a0b7d99f5d77eafc385f62bf5cf9de4b3920d; layers and RootFS diffIDs match; both OCI archives SHA-256 BB7E45AB1E9E7B4C3770C799691F5B65BB6D12EBEC05FD0F5A0DCC60FBE507C2.

gates.name: Container security
gates.command: docker inspect mini-llm-gateway:wave52-candidate-5a474c2; docker scout sbom --format cyclonedx --output wave52-candidate-sbom-verify.cdx.json local://mini-llm-gateway:wave52-candidate-5a474c2; isolated Compose Chat/SSE smoke
gates.reviewer_note: Observed UID 10001, read-only root filesystem, all Linux capabilities dropped, no-new-privileges and required /tmp tmpfs. Candidate CycloneDX 1.5 SBOM contains 177 components. The separate vulnerability gate remains failed (R04).

gates.name: Critical/High vulnerability disposition
gates.command: Trivy 0.75.0 image scan; refreshed vulnerability database; severity includes HIGH,CRITICAL
gates.failure_reason: 0 Critical and 44 High findings remain; there is no approved human risk disposition.
gates.reviewer_note: Remaining High CVEs: CVE-2025-69720, CVE-2026-16742, CVE-2026-54369, CVE-2026-76642, CVE-2026-78408, CVE-2026-78409, CVE-2026-78410, CVE-2026-9538. Scanner exit 0 means scan completed, not policy pass.

gates.name: PostgreSQL outage and recovery
gates.reviewer_note: Six SIGKILL outage rounds; oracle_pass=true. All request responses were 503, /live stayed 200, /ready was 503 while PostgreSQL was down, no request audit/reservation was created during outage, and each recovered database returned to ready.

gates.name: Wire-level Commit Unknown
gates.failure_reason: No protocol-aware proxy or socket fault dropped the actual PostgreSQL COMMIT acknowledgement.
gates.reviewer_note: The prior application-level synthetic Commit Unknown probe is not wire-level evidence.

gates.name: Two-version rollback
gates.command: docker compose -p wave52-rollback -f deploy/wave5/compose.yaml up -d --no-build with GATEWAY_IMAGE old c4ba57d, new 5a474c2, then old c4ba57d
gates.reviewer_note: Old→new→old readiness, Chat HTTP 200 and native SSE event: done succeeded. One harness assertion initially looked for [DONE]; the preserved SSE body showed this gateway's named done event and the corrected contract check passed. Timing is recorded only as approximate evidence-file intervals, not isolated deployment stopwatch measurements.

gates.name: OTel/Prometheus verified
gates.command: GET /metrics (historical local check); isolated Chat/SSE smoke
gates.failure_reason: No OTel Collector trace backend query or Prometheus scrape/query was run for the fixed candidate.
gates.reviewer_note: Endpoint availability and structured logs are not end-to-end correlation proof.

gates.name: Network security verified
gates.command: Host/Docker/BuildKit HTTPS proxy probes via port 7897
gates.failure_reason: No live DNS rebinding, redirect, private/metadata destination, IPv6, or proxy-bypass test against provider egress was run.
gates.reviewer_note: Proxy reachability is transport plumbing only; application egress policy is not accepted.

gates.name: Performance evidence verified
gates.command: scripts/run_experiment.py; isolated mock HTTP Chat; concurrency 1/8/32/64, three repetitions, each 10s duration warmup and 30s formal
gates.failure_reason: The valid rerun had 100% success at concurrency 1 and 8, but 90.71% at 32 and 33.61% at 64. DB unavailable and stream_finalization_unknown responses plus 614 expired reservations requiring reconciliation make the measured workload unsuitable for release acceptance.
gates.reviewer_note: No SSE TTFT was measured in this HTTP Chat matrix; CPU peaked 187.54%, RSS 91.19 MiB without resource quotas. Reconciliation subsequently released all 614 expired reservations with unique release finalizations; it does not erase the failed performance result.

gates.name: GitHub CI and artifact integrity
gates.command: git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/codex/wave51-release-closure; GitHub Actions run 38022155005; gh run download 38022155005; independent manifest hash check

Evidence artifact 11658898079 and Validation artifact 11658698105.
